about: Where the hand-back export looks for the club's hours / fees workbooks (the docs-pagefix US file is keyed by the workbook's Parks-sheet row). Env vars KPC_HF_WORKBOOK_US / KPC_HF_WORKBOOK_CA win; then these file names in these folders (relative folders are from the engine folder; the --out folder and its parent are always tried). No workbook = the ref is written with a 'mapping needed' note.
